resources.string: Connect to a trusted Wi-Fi or Ethernet network.
AirPlay mirroring + audio · DLNA media playback
Experimental AirPlay compatibility. No Google Cast, Miracast, DRM or AirPlay 2 multiroom. Keep this app open; all receivers stop when you leave.
Use a trusted local network. Nearby devices on this network can request playback. Do not expose receiver ports to the Internet.
Open the app to receive automatically. Select this TV in iPhone Screen Mirroring or a DLNA-compatible video app.
OK / Menu: show controls · Back: controls or exit · Media keys: playback
Only selects existing Media3 tracks. AirPlay mirror requests are configured separately. Neither restores source detail.

AirPlay: UxPlay-based video and audio reception.
DLNA: discovery and clear network-media playback.
MoonCast / GameStream: install the MoonCast phone sender, select Connect Android phone on the TV, and confirm first-time pairing. H.264 SDR / 48 kHz stereo, view-only.

Android system casting may use Miracast, Google Cast or OEM-integrated Lelink; these are not implemented here. GameStream does not appear in the system Cast picker.
Framing and proportional zoom apply to all three playback paths. GameStream uses low-latency output with no signed audio offset.
Experimental software: physical phone/TV compatibility and end-to-end latency remain unverified. No DRM bypass.
GPLv3; pinned upstream sources and licenses accompany distribution.
Up/down: select · Left/right: 1% (hold: 5%) · OK: save · Back: cancel · Menu: reset
Burned-in subtitles move with the picture. Crop carefully; Menu restores the whole image.
One app-wide choice. Auto detects fresh borders for each video; it never reuses another video’s detected coordinates.
Cinema locked · rescan for new content
Negotiation preference, not actual received resolution. Reconnect the sender after applying.
A real prebuffer, not signed A/V offset. More buffering may reduce dropouts but adds latency. Native signed audio offset is unavailable.
Only URL/HLS/DASH playback. Positive delays sound; negative skips initial PCM to advance sound. Applying restarts at the current position. Not an AirPlay mirror audio control.
Movie favors smoother playback. Low latency can stutter on weak networks. No measured end-to-end latency guarantee.
Current playback stops. Reconnect from the phone after the receiver is ready. Saved receiver identity is preserved.
Recover after control connections close and media remains silent. Static or paused video alone is not disconnection. Recovery keeps receiver identity and cannot force the phone to reconnect.
This disconnects playback and permanently resets this receiver key and network identity. Senders may need to find this TV again. No PIN is required. Automatic recovery never deletes identity.
Receiver identity reset. Select this TV again on your phone.
Session cleared; ready for a new connection
Sender names and per-device revocation are unavailable. This receiver accepts devices on your trusted LAN without a PIN.
Identity reset failed; receiver stays stopped
Mirror request: %1$d × %2$d @ %3$d fps · audio prebuffer %4$d ms (0 = adaptive)
Framing widened to protect newly visible content
Choose this TV from your phone. Playback appears here automatically.
AirPlay is not fully ready. Check Advanced → Diagnostics.
Reopen the app to retry DLNA. Details are in Advanced → Diagnostics.

Use the same MoonCast app on both Android devices, on one trusted LAN.

Android AirPlay: on the phone choose AirPlay, select this TV in My TV and approve screen sharing.
Android Moonlight: start the phone host, choose Connect Android phone on the TV and complete GameStream PIN pairing.
iPhone / iPad: Screen Mirroring → select this TV.
DLNA: choose this receiver in a compatible media app.

APK sending is separate: enable Install phone APK on TV, select a file and this TV on the phone, then confirm installation on TV. APK transfer has no pairing code.

Miracast, Chromecast and OEM system Cast menus are different protocols and are not implemented here.
Changing device mode stops the current receiving or APK-transfer session.
